title: Quick check: JavaScript Objects and Arrays

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “JavaScript Objects and Arrays”?
options: Object properties should preserve stable identity and render the UI derived from the current data.
The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
questions.answer_key: Object properties should preserve stable identity and render the UI derived from the current data.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in JavaScript Objects and Arrays: Object properties should preserve stable identity and render the UI derived from the current data.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying Object properties?
options: Skip validation because a successful render proves that the application is correct.
Store duplicate copies of every value so each component can change it independently.
Optimize by adding every available Hook without measuring the result.
Use stable identifiers as keys and derive visible lists from current data.
questions.answer_key: Use stable identifiers as keys and derive visible lists from current data.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in JavaScript Objects and Arrays: Use stable identifiers as keys and derive visible lists from current data.
